toolsPreview.name: get_quote
toolsPreview.description: Use this whenever the user wants travel-insurance quotes. Returns priced offers from HelloSafe partners and renders the comparison widget. Required: countryResidence, arrivalCountries, traveller age(s). Everything else has a sensible default — never ask the user for an optional field. After calling, reply with 1-2 short sentences highlighting the recommended offer — never re-list offers as a table, never paste subscribe URLs.
